altJa: 淡い背景に、橙色で丸くやや平たい果実を一個描いています。皮に細かな凹凸があり、上部には小さな緑がかったへたが付いています。
observationJa: 果実全体の丸みとやや平たい輪郭、皮の細かな凹凸、上部の小さなへたを見ます。色だけでなく、輪郭や表面も観察します。
limitJa: 一般的な外観の一例です。橙色だけで他のかんきつと区別せず、この図だけで品種や種類、熟度、品質、食べられるかどうかを判定しません。

generation.exactPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original fruit-name recognition illustration for an adult Japanese agriculture learning app. Create ONE whole common unshu mikan / satsuma mandarin fruit, gently squat and round with subtly flattened upper and lower ends, orange finely dimpled citrus peel, and a small naturally attached greenish calyx button at the top. Gentle botanical 2D watercolor/gouache illustration, restrained shading, clear complete contour, quiet warm ivory background matching a calm educational fruit atlas. Centre in a square composition viewed slightly from above, with entire fruit and calyx inside comfortable margins. Peel texture should have fine small citrus pores, not the large irregular lumpy deeply bumpy rind typical of a yuzu illustration. No green leaf, tall stem, cut face, separated segments, peeled section, seeds or dissection. One fruit only, no comparison fruit, plate, hands, ruler, text, labels, letters, numbers, badges, logos, arrows, watermark or decorative frame. This is one common appearance example, no named cultivar, no universal outline rule and no ripeness, sweetness, quality, species-identification or edibility claim based on colour. Entirely original composition, do not copy a textbook photograph or page layout. No input/reference images.
